description: Executive operating cockpit for Nzila Ventures. Read-only aggregator across Console, Platform Admin, and Control Plane. Surfaces portfolio health, founder dependency, opportunity pipeline, and delegation queues. Does not own operational data and does not bypass authoritative systems.
nonNegotiableRules: Nzila HQ MUST NOT duplicate Console operational dashboards
Nzila HQ MUST NOT replace Platform Admin tenant/user/billing flows
Nzila HQ MUST NOT replace Control Plane policy/approval/evidence flows
All cross-app data is read-only or deep-linked
All API routes must call resolveOrgContext() before processing
All mutations must be routed through Control Plane (no shadow writes)
RBAC roles enforced via @nzila/hq-domain HqRole and lib/rbac.ts
